question: Should OpenClaw add a duplicate top-level `auth list` public command and make `auth` a plugin-yielding core root, or retain `models auth list` as the sole canonical surface?
rationale: Both choices are technically possible, but they establish different long-term CLI ownership, compatibility, documentation, and deprecation contracts that cannot be selected safely from implementation evidence alone.

options.title: Keep the canonical models command
options.body: Decline the new root and improve discovery of `openclaw models auth list` without creating a second public contract or a special plugin-collision rule.

options.title: Approve the conditional alias
options.body: Accept the new root only after documenting plugin precedence and supplying live proof for both fallback and plugin-owned installations.

recommendation.title: Keep the canonical models command
recommendation.body: Decline the new root and improve discovery of `openclaw models auth list` without creating a second public contract or a special plugin-collision rule.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision directly changes the descriptor-backed plugin CLI ownership contract introduced in their merged work.
